Enum Class AlgoSignalKind

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<AlgoSignalKind>
grafioschtrader.types.AlgoSignalKind
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<AlgoSignalKind>, Constable
public enum AlgoSignalKind extends Enum<AlgoSignalKind>
Kind of signal an algo evaluation produced. It is one component of the identity that daily deduplication works on, so two different kinds fired on the same day for the same instrument are two alarms rather than one.

The values 1 to 6 are the ones the algo_message_alert.alarm_type column has always documented. Only the alert kinds are produced today; the trading kinds are reserved for the strategy signals that later strategy modules add through the same notification path, and their numbers must not be reused for anything else.
